svg.title: AST matching still runs after token collection
svg.desc: The direct matchAST() call is replaced by afterExecute(), which releases a deferred MatchFinder consumer callback. ParsedAST still consumes tokens and restricts traversal before invoking afterExecute(). HandleTranslationUnit records the AST first; run() executes the delegate only after those steps.
svg.text: AST matching still runs after token collection
The direct matchAST() call is replaced by afterExecute(), which releases a deferred MatchFinder consumer callback.
